title: Understanding Regularization
text: When you increase the regularization coefficient \( \lambda \), think about how it affects the model's complexity. Does it make the model more flexible or more constrained?

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Consider the trade-off between bias and variance. As \( \lambda \) increases, how does it affect the bias of the model? Remember, bias is related to the error due to overly simplistic assumptions in the learning algorithm.
